company.name: May Mobility
company.shortDescription: May Mobility is a manufacturing firm that designs and develops autonomous technology vehicles for self-driving transportation solutions.
company.description: May Mobility specializes in autonomous vehicle technology development and deployment. The company's technology studies the city's traffic and commuter flow, identifying bottlenecks and gaps in the current public transit schema to design the optimal routes for communities. The company also offers a fleet operation service and provides daily transit by deploying autonomous shuttles to reduce human error in driving, reduce pollution, and create greater economic benefit for communities and riders, enabling public transportation systems to create a safer, greener, more efficient environment.

productsAndServices.description: An autonomous driving platform combining a predictive world model, multi-policy reasoning engine, sensor stack and drive-by-wire controls to operate vehicles in real-time across varied road environments.

productsAndServices.description: Autonomous vehicle services for college and commercial campuses, airports, healthcare centers and other private sites, supporting passenger shuttles and potential middle-mile delivery.

aiResearchSummary.text: May Mobility is researching methods and systems for impact-based operation of an autonomous agent, feasibility-based operation of an autonomous agent, and conditional operation of an autonomous agent that select and evaluate driving policies from sensor inputs. They develop tracking by a vehicle, predicting external agent behavior, and dynamically updating an environmental representation, supported by an autonomous vehicle safety platform, remote assistance, risk assessment, dynamic policy curation, multimodal safety operations, and calibration of infrastructure devices.
